plain: Inactive for now but able to wake up later.

webster.text: Sleeping; hence, at rest; not in action; as dormant passions.

more.text: Neglected; not used; as a dormant title; dormant privileges.

example.quote: The claim is dormant, and will prol)ably never be revived.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 21, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
